defects.claim: Description: 'Kneel upright with both knees down'. Currently rightHip=0 (thigh vertical), rightKnee=10 (nearly straight). Right leg is standing straight, foot planted below. Should be kneeling (thigh forward, knee bent) matching left leg.
defects.evidence: geometry.json: right_leg hip_flexion_deg=0, knee_flexion_deg=10 (straight); rightFoot y=-0.84 (planted below hip, not kneeling).

defects.claim: Description: 'arch the spine backward'. Currently spine=-4 (barely arched). Need deeper back arch for 'arch' (e.g., -25 to -30).

Description: 'reaching both arms overhead AND BEHIND you'. Currently arms overhead (leftShoulder=-110, rightShoulder=-110) but shoulderFwdL/R not set (default 0, no forward/back). For 'behind', need shoulderFwdL/R positive per corrected convention (+ = behind).
defects.evidence: geometry.json: left_arm/right_arm shoulder_sagittal_flexion_deg=174.6 (forward, in plane); no behind component.

rationale: Description: 'Kneel upright with both knees down, arch the spine backward, reaching both arms overhead and behind you. Head follows arch.' (1) Right leg kneeling: rightHip 0→80 (match left), rightKnee 10→90 (match left), rightAnkle added=-35 (match left). (2) Spine arch: -4→-30 (deep back arch per 'arch the spine backward'). (3) Arms behind: shoulderFwdL/R added=+25 (positive = behind per corrected convention). (4) Elbows 70/50→40/40 (straighter for reaching up/behind; symmetric). (5) neck -18→0 (no side tilt; 'head follows arch' via spine extension producing head pitch back, no roll needed). Rig limitation: hip origin y=0.12 prevents true knee-on-ground; deep-knee-flexion is kneeling approximation.
